name: behique
notes: Behique's own dashboard, checked by Behique (dogfood). The checkout is a git worktree of this repo at the given ref, so the app under test is that commit's demo/server.mjs and ui/behique-live.html; uncommitted working-tree changes are not part of any ref. npm ci runs with scripts off (the three dependencies need none for the dashboard; no browser is downloaded). demo/server.mjs listens on localhost only, and the sandbox launcher relays it. The dashboard is only interesting with cases in out/evidence, and out/ is git-ignored, so a fresh checkout has none. The profile format has no way to put a file into a non-database checkout (seed entries load sidecar databases, prepare commands may not run inline code), so two small PUBLIC-app cases (Hoppscotch 2025.10.1 vs 2025.11.2 and FreshRSS 1.29.1 vs 1.30.0, about 0.9 MB) are kept in src/release/onboard/seeds/behique/evidence/ and copied into each checkout's out/evidence before a run (see docs/dogfood-behique.md). The same two cases are on both refs, so both versions render the same report. Runs only in the Docker sandbox.
